correctness.rationale: The explicit polynomial factorization shows that all six prescribed Fourier values vanish for every prime p congruent 7 mod 24; all coefficients are nonzero. The p=7 sharp lower bound reduces by translation to exactly 213053 principal submatrices with origin included. The supplied complete C++17 program checks a prime coefficient modulus, primitive root of order seven, and exact nonzero determinants for all required submatrices; a complex cyclotomic determinant zero would reduce to zero modulo the checked prime. Thus the exact finite certificate proves absence of all smaller supports, and the all-prime construction is analytic.

value.rationale: This directly addresses the smallest support in a Fourier self-disjointness problem posed as difficult in primary 2026 literature. It supplies an exact sharp minimum at the first untreated prime and a constant-size construction for an infinite class where the known construction used 2p-2 points; these are natural invariant and structural improvements, not unmotivated parameter tweaks.
